evaluation_protocol: Stratified 80/20 DEV/TEST split (seed 42). 5-fold stratified CV on DEV gives out-of-fold probabilities used to rank models, tune hybrid weights and fit stacking meta-learners. TEST is used once for the reported scores; 95% CIs by 600 bootstrap resamples. Default model = hybrid with best DEV-CV macro-F1 (never selected on TEST).
caveats: Workbook labels were generated automatically, not by FIDIC experts: scores measure agreement with those labels, not legal correctness.
OCR noise (ORANGE/SILVER books) and Indonesian rows were removed; RED and YELLOW books share many near-identical clauses, which can inflate scores.
Heading augmentation (sub-clause titles harvested from cross-references) is used for training only, never in TEST.

hybrid_descriptions.Hybrid: Majority Vote (Top-3): Each of the three best individual models (by cross-validated macro-F1) casts one vote; ties broken by summed probability.
hybrid_descriptions.Hybrid: Competitive Voting (Thesis, Top-: Eken (2022) §5.6: if ≥2 of the top-3 models agree, take the majority; if all three differ, take the prediction of the most accurate model.
hybrid_descriptions.Hybrid: Confidence-Weighted Vote (Top-3): Each top-3 model adds its confidence to the class it predicts; the class with the largest confidence mass wins.
hybrid_descriptions.Hybrid: Rank-Weighted Vote (Top-3): Top-3 models receive weights 3, 2, 1 by cross-validated rank; weighted soft vote of their probabilities.
hybrid_descriptions.Hybrid: Optimized Soft Voting (Top-5): Non-negative weights for the five best models chosen by Dirichlet search to maximise out-of-fold macro-F1.
hybrid_descriptions.Hybrid: Stacking Meta-Learner (All model: A multinomial logistic-regression meta-learner trained on the out-of-fold probabilities of every individual model.
hybrid_descriptions.Hybrid: ML + Rule-Based Stacking: Stacking meta-learner fed with the top-5 models' probabilities plus 28 linguistic rule cues (modal verbs, liability, discretion, party mentions …) — the rule integration recommended in thesis §6.2.
hybrid_descriptions.Hybrid: Thesis Hierarchical Binary Decom: Eken (2022) §5.3 Step 2: Heading vs Clause → Definition vs Other → Obligation vs Other → Risk vs Right, each stage a soft vote of TF-IDF LR, TF-IDF SVM and char-SVM.
